newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka seeks 250,000 bbls diesel for Aug 11-12.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka seeks 250,000 bbls diesel for Aug 11-12.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy 1.0-percent sulphur diesel for August 11-12 delivery, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Colombo, a CPC official said on Monday.
CPC seeks 250,000 barrels of diesel in the tender, which closes on July 23 and offers should be valid for two days, he said.
He said CPC was not seeking jet fuel this time because it had sufficient stocks.

In its last tender for July 27-28 delivery, Sri Lanka purchased from Shell 235,000 barrels of 1.0 percent sulphur diesel at 21.9 cents per barrel premium to Singapore spot quotes, and 65,000 barrels of jet fuel at a 9.4-cent premium, c-and-f Colombo.
